# ReferendumCitoyen — account brief

## Who

ReferendumCitoyen is a GitHub organization with 2 public repos and 5 followers ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen)). The evidence does not say what the company does beyond its GitHub org profile ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `referendum-citoyen-react-native` ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/eas.json)).
- The repo runs react-native 0.81.5 per its `package.json` ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/tree/develop/.github/workflows)).
- The repo was last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native)).

## Who to talk to

- @referendumcitoyenfr, top contributor to `referendum-citoyen-react-native` with 230 commits ([source](https://github.com/referendumcitoyenfr)). The record lists no company, location, or bio.
- @rachyandco, 172 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/rachyandco)). The record lists no company, location, or bio.
- Yaroslav Panasenko (@Volendi), 1 commit ([source](https://github.com/Volendi)). The record lists no company, location, or bio.

## Why now

The repo was last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native)) and runs react-native 0.81.5 ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/package.json)). No evidence of store update cadence.

## Suggested opener

Hi @referendumcitoyenfr — you have 230 commits on `referendum-citoyen-react-native` ([source](https://github.com/referendumcitoyenfr)), which carries an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/blob/develop/eas.json)) alongside workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native/tree/develop/.github/workflows)). The repo was last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/ReferendumCitoyen/referendum-citoyen-react-native)). When you cut a build from `develop`, does it go through those GitHub workflows or do you trigger EAS builds by hand?
